# ankra_project (Data Source)

Looks up one project of the organisation by ID or slug, for example to pin a token or scope a resource to it by ID. Fails when no project the token's user can reach matches, and while projects are not enabled for the organisation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_project" "default" {
  project = "default"
}

output "default_project_id" {
  value = data.ankra_project.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project to look up, by ID or slug (`default` names the organisation's default project).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created.
- `description` (String) Description; empty when none is set.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default project.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Slug, which never changes.
